response.sql:
WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(count) as avg_all_colleges,
        SUM(count) as total_all_counts
    FROM college_counts
),
above_average_colleges AS (
    SELECT count
    FROM college_counts
    WHERE count > (SELECT avg_all_colleges FROM stats)
)
SELECT 
    AVG(count),
    AVG(CAST(count AS NUMERIC) / (SELECT total_all_counts FROM stats)),
    AVG(count - (SELECT avg_all_colleges FROM stats))
FROM above_average_colleges;

alternatives.interpretation: For (2): interpret as '(the average count among above-average colleges) divided by (the total count of all colleges)' rather than 'the average of each college's individual count divided by the total'.
